items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yes, I liked him because he played in my band.

ctx.x: Did you get to know him well?

Oh, yes, I liked him because he played in my band. I liked him very much. In fact, they thought that I was -- I always got hung up with them -- and when I brought that Cadillac over there, one of them said come on, get in the car -- naw, I ain't gonna get in it. I said, come on -- I thought you was from Guadalupe and you from America. And that's what happened.
